case.title: The Safe House Affair
case.introduction: Tonight at The Ashgrove Safe House, the forgery and swap of a masterpiece painting has thrown the evening into chaos. No one may leave. 5 guests remain — each with something to hide. One of them is not who they claim to be. Find them.
case.crime: The forgery and swap of a masterpiece painting
case.escape_plan: Isabella Marchetti intends to slip out during the confusion and vanish before the authorities arrive.

rooms.name: The Grand Lobby
rooms.description: A vast marble hall with a sweeping staircase.

rooms.name: The Lounge
rooms.description: Low amber lighting, leather chairs, a jazz record spinning.

rooms.name: The Dining Room
rooms.description: A long table still set for the evening's dinner.

rooms.name: The Private Study
rooms.description: Bookshelves, a heavy desk, a locked drawer.

rooms.name: The Terrace Garden
rooms.description: Night air, hedges, and a view of the water.

rooms.name: The Guest Quarters
rooms.description: A corridor of numbered doors, most left ajar.

characters.goal: Rowan wants to appear cooperative while hiding a secret.

knowledge: Saw Isabella Marchetti acting strangely near the The Grand Lobby.

characters.name: Isabella Marchetti

characters.secret: Isabella is protecting a family member.

timeline.description: The incident: the forgery and swap of a masterpiece painting.
Alarm raised; the site is sealed.
Isabella Marchetti is seen slipping toward an exit.

evidence.name: a ledger page
evidence.description: A page of figures that don't add up.

evidence.name: a forged passport
evidence.description: A convincing passport with a subtly wrong birth year.

evidence.name: a hidden key
evidence.description: A small brass key taped beneath a drawer.

evidence.name: a photograph
evidence.description: A candid photo of two guests who claim never to have met.

evidence.name: a torn train ticket
evidence.description: A ticket stub torn in half, timestamped earlier than claimed.

evidence.name: a bloodstained handkerchief
evidence.description: Fine linen with a monogram and a dark stain.

hidden_clues: Isabella Marchetti's account of their whereabouts conflicts with the a ledger page.
Two guests deny a relationship that a photograph proves.

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted operative posing as security consultant
solution.reasoning: Isabella Marchetti is the hidden target: the key evidence (a ledger page, a forged passport) places them at the scene and contradicts their alibi, while their documents are forged.

state.current_objective: Identify the hidden target among the suspects.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Tonight at The Ashgrove Safe House, the forgery and swap of a masterpiece painting has thrown the evening into chaos. No one may leave. 5 guests remain — each with something to hide. One of them is not who they claim to be. Find them.

transcript.speaker: Emma Ashford
transcript.text: Why should I tell you anything? Prove I can trust you first.

transcript.speaker: Hint
transcript.text: Compare each suspect's stated alibi against the physical evidence you've found. The person whose story contradicts the key evidence — and whose documents don't quite add up — is the one to watch.
